verdict.rationale: Motion publishes a pricing page that names at least one tier (Business AI, 'for power users and businesses with complex needs'), lists included features such as Gantt charts, time tracking, capacity planning, permissions and dashboards, and states a per-seat allotment of 15,000 credits/seat/month. Its llms.txt overview also covers pricing. However, no evidence shows the actual per-seat price of any tier, so the core 'exactly what each tier costs' part is unproven. Missing for 10: actual per-seat dollar prices per tier, a full multi-tier comparison of inclusions, and independent confirmation that pricing is self-serve without a sales call.
